dialogue.content: ぺんぺんさん、こんにちは。バッシーと申します。今日はよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Hello, Penpen-san. My name is Basshi. I look forward to working with you today.

dialogue.content: こちらこそよろしくお願いします！
dialogue.English: It's nice to meet you too!

dialogue.content: 定刻になりましたら、始めさせていただきます！
dialogue.English: We'll begin at the scheduled time!

dialogue.content: はい！
dialogue.English: Okay!

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 家とか学校が辛くて相談しにきました.....
dialogue.English: I came to talk because things are difficult at home and at school...

dialogue.content: 相談にきていただきありがとうございます。家も学校も辛いというのはかなり心が疲れているように思います。
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming to talk with me. Feeling that both home and school are difficult must be very emotionally draining.

dialogue.content: すごく疲れました…
dialogue.English: I'm so tired...

dialogue.content: ストレスを溜め込んでいるように感じます。
dialogue.English: It sounds like you're holding in a lot of stress.

dialogue.content: ストレスを解消できるような状況ではないのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is it hard to find ways to relieve that stress?

dialogue.content: ストレスがあるかどうかわかりませんが趣味はあるのでそこで解消はできてるのかな？とは思います…
dialogue.English: I'm not sure if I'm stressed, but I have hobbies, so I think maybe I'm able to relieve it through them...

dialogue.content: 趣味があるので、解消できていることがあるのですね
dialogue.English: So you have hobbies that help you relieve some of it.

dialogue.content: ちなみにどのような趣味をもたれているのか教えてもらえますか？
dialogue.English: By the way, could you tell me what kinds of hobbies you have?

dialogue.content: 読書です
dialogue.English: Reading.

dialogue.content: 読書ですね。
dialogue.English: Reading, I see.

dialogue.content: 読書の時間が今一番落ち着く時間なのですね
dialogue.English: So, the time you spend reading is when you feel most at peace right now.

dialogue.content: 何も考えなくていいし没頭できるから
dialogue.English: Because I don't have to think about anything and can just get absorbed in it.

dialogue.content: 自分の時間を大切にしているように思います
dialogue.English: It sounds like you value your personal time.

dialogue.content: 遅れましたが、あなたの性別と年齢を良ければ教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: I should have asked earlier, but if you don't mind, could you please tell me your gender and age?

dialogue.content: 女の子で14です
dialogue.English: I'm a girl, 14.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。学年は中学２年生ですか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. Are you in the second year of junior high school?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます昨年中学校に入学して１年がたちましたが、色々な変化がありましたか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. It's been a year since you started middle school. Have there been a lot of changes?

dialogue.content: そうですね仲がいい友達がみんな他のクラスにいってしまったりしています。
dialogue.English: Yes, all of my close friends ended up in different classes.

dialogue.content: 親しい友達が他クラスにいき、寂しい気持ちなのですね
dialogue.English: Your close friends are in other classes, so you're feeling lonely.

dialogue.content: 寂しいのもあるし周りとうまくいってない
dialogue.English: It's partly loneliness, and I'm also not getting along with the people around me.

dialogue.content: 在籍しているクラスでは親しい友達がなかなかできない状況なのですか？
dialogue.English: In your current class, is it difficult to make close friends?

dialogue.content: そうなのですね友人関係がうまくいっていないと登校も気が引けてしいがちになりますよね
dialogue.English: I see. When friendships aren't going well, it can certainly make you reluctant to go to school.

dialogue.content: 学校の悩みは友人関係が１番大きいのでしょうか
dialogue.English: Are friendship problems the biggest issue for you at school?

dialogue.content: 友達関係というよりいじめられてて小学校からの仲がいい友達が1人いたけど、あまりかかわりたくなさそう
dialogue.English: It's less about friendships and more that I'm being bullied. I had one good friend from elementary school, but she doesn't seem to want to be involved with me much.

dialogue.content: いじめを受けているということで、仲が良い友人も距離をおくようになってしまっているのですね
dialogue.English: So, because you're being bullied, even your close friend is starting to keep their distance.

dialogue.content: 誰にも相談できる相手がいないよう状況なのですね
dialogue.English: It sounds like you don't have anyone you can talk to about this.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: １人で抱え込むのはとてもつらいですよね
dialogue.English: It must be very painful to carry that all by yourself.

dialogue.content: 家庭にもなかなか相談しずらいのでしょうか
dialogue.English: Is it difficult to talk to your family about it as well?

dialogue.content: 相談したけど、あまり理解してくれなかった
dialogue.English: I did talk to them, but they weren't very understanding.

dialogue.content: （家族が）理解してくれなかったのですね。その内容について、良かったら可能な範囲で構わないで話してもらますか？
dialogue.English: So your family wasn't understanding. If you'd like, could you tell me about that, just as much as you're comfortable sharing?

dialogue.content: 私の方をみてこそこそ話して笑ったり、触ると汚れたと言われたり、はぶかれたりされてます。
dialogue.English: They look at me, whisper and laugh, say they've gotten 'dirty' if they touch me, and leave me out.

dialogue.content: ありがとうござます！クラスメートからこそこそ話して笑われたり、触ると「汚れた」と言われてはぶかれたりされることに対して、家族に理解してもらえないということですか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for telling me. So is it that your family doesn't understand about your classmates whispering and laughing, saying they get 'dirty' if they touch you, and excluding you?

dialogue.content: そのような状況だと、家庭も学校も辛いと思い居場所がないと感じるのも無理はないとおもいます
dialogue.English: In a situation like that, it's completely understandable that you'd feel that both home and school are difficult and that you have nowhere to belong.

dialogue.content: 最初は担任言ってくれたりしたけど、結局改善されなくて、学校も行きたくなくて休みたいって言ったけど、所詮は子どものいじめだからって言われた
dialogue.English: At first, my homeroom teacher talked to them, but it didn't get any better. When I said I didn't want to go to school and wanted to stay home, I was told it was just kids' bullying.

dialogue.content: 担任の先生にも相談したけど改善には至らなかったし、家庭では子どものいじめととらえて向き合ってくれなかったことが悲しいし、悔しかったのですね
dialogue.English: So you talked to your homeroom teacher but it didn't lead to any improvement, and at home, they dismissed it as just children's bullying and didn't really address it with you. That must have been sad and frustrating.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 学校や家庭の大人にはあなたのこの悩みを何度も伝えたのですか？
dialogue.English: Have you told the adults at school and at home about these concerns multiple times?

dialogue.content: 例えば学校だと保健室の先生やスクールカウンセラーがいると思います
dialogue.English: For example, at school, there should be a school nurse or a school counselor.

dialogue.content: その大人に相談はしたことがありますか？
dialogue.English: Have you ever tried talking to them?

dialogue.content: もともとは、1年生のときからいじめられててその時から伝えてるし相談してる
dialogue.English: Actually, I've been bullied since my first year, and I've been telling people and trying to get help since then.

dialogue.content: 保険室の先生は最初の先生は優しかったけど次にきた先生は相談しにくい先生だしカウンセラーいるかどうか分からない
dialogue.English: The first school nurse was kind, but the new one is hard to talk to, and I don't know if we even have a counselor.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね最初の保健室の先生が異動され、新しく赴任した保健室の先生には相談しにくいのですね
dialogue.English: I see. So the first school nurse transferred, and you find it hard to talk to the new one.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: あなたにとって信用できた最初の保健室の先生が異動されたことはショックだったと察します
dialogue.English: I imagine it must have been a shock when the school nurse you trusted was transferred.

dialogue.content: またスクールカウンセラーの有無については、少しでも信用のおける教職員に尋ねてみてはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: As for whether there's a school counselor, perhaps you could try asking a teacher or staff member you trust, even a little?

dialogue.content: そうですね、、、寂しかったです、、、
dialogue.English: Yeah... I felt so lonely...

dialogue.content: どの先生が信用できるのか分からない、、、
dialogue.English: I don't know which teachers I can trust...

dialogue.content: うんうん、寂しいですよね
dialogue.English: Mm-hm, that must be lonely.

dialogue.content: １人でもやもやしながら過ごすことって辛いですよね
dialogue.English: It's hard to go through your days feeling this frustration all by yourself, isn't it?

dialogue.content: ちなみに教科担当の先生や学年主任の先生と話したりする機会はこれまでにありましたか？
dialogue.English: By the way, have you had a chance to talk with any of your subject teachers or the head of your grade?

dialogue.content: 学年主任の先生はどっちかというと昔ながらの先生って感じでいじめもあまりりかいしてくれない
dialogue.English: The head of our grade is more of an old-fashioned type of teacher and doesn't really understand bullying.

dialogue.content: 昔ながらですか・・・それって「いじめに立ち向かえ！」「いじめに負けるな！」とかの根性論みたいな感じ？
dialogue.English: Old-fashioned... you mean the type who would say things based on willpower, like, "Stand up to the bullies!" or "Don't let them beat you!"?

dialogue.content: 今の時期、夏休みに入ったと思います１人の時間が多くなると思います
dialogue.English: Around this time of year, I believe summer vacation has started, so you'll probably have more time to yourself.

dialogue.content: そんな感じです、、、私たちがいうよりも自分から行動してって言われて言いたいことなんとなく分かるけど、、、
dialogue.English: It's like that... I'm told I need to take action myself rather than just talk about it. I kind of get what they mean, but...

dialogue.content: 早く夏休み入ってほしい
dialogue.English: I just want summer vacation to start already.

dialogue.content: それだとあなたの気持ちに寄り添うことは難しいなと考えます
dialogue.English: In that case, I imagine it's difficult for them to empathize with your feelings.

dialogue.content: まだ夏休みに入っていないということは、特別授業や学校行事とかがあるからですか？
dialogue.English: Does the fact that summer vacation hasn't started yet mean you still have special classes or school events?

dialogue.content: そうです、でも今週で終わります
dialogue.English: Yes, but it ends this week.

dialogue.content: 夏休みに入れば１人の時間が確保できるので気持ち的にも楽になりますよね
dialogue.English: Once summer vacation starts, you'll be able to have time to yourself, which will probably be a relief emotionally, right?

dialogue.content: 楽になります
dialogue.English: It will be a relief.

dialogue.content: そうですよね夏休みをどのように過ごしたいと考えていますか？
dialogue.English: Right. How would you like to spend your summer vacation?

dialogue.content: 読書したり、ゲームしたり、家族旅行があるので旅行いきます
dialogue.English: Read, play games, and we have a family trip, so I'll go on that.

dialogue.content: 楽しい夏休みが待っていますね！家族旅行もあり、家族とのコミュニケーションも多くもてますね
dialogue.English: It sounds like a fun summer vacation is waiting for you! With a family trip, you'll also have more opportunities to communicate with your family.

dialogue.content: でも、夏休みが終わるの考えるとしんどい
dialogue.English: But it's hard when I think about summer vacation ending.

dialogue.content: 確かにそうですね夏休みを終えてからのことを考えると不安ですよね
dialogue.English: That's true. It's natural to feel anxious when you think about what happens after the vacation is over.

dialogue.content: ぺんぺんさんは、今の状況をどうしたいと考えていますか？
dialogue.English: Penpen-san, what would you like to see happen with your current situation?

dialogue.content: いじめがなく平和にすごしたい
dialogue.English: I want the bullying to stop so I can live peacefully.

dialogue.content: それが一番ですよねそのために夏休みをどのように送ると良いと考えていますか？
dialogue.English: That's the most important thing, isn't it? To that end, how do you think it would be best to spend your summer vacation?

dialogue.content: とりあえず、夏休みを楽しむ？
dialogue.English: For now, just enjoy the summer vacation?

dialogue.content: 楽しく過ごすことは大切ですね！
dialogue.English: Enjoying yourself is very important!

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: また読書をされいるのであれば、そこから様々な気づきが得られ、これからの生活のヒントが得られるかもしれませんね
dialogue.English: And since you enjoy reading, you might find various insights or hints for your life ahead in your books.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 私の意見ですが、なかなか周囲の状況は変わらないと思います
dialogue.English: This is just my opinion, but I think it's often difficult for the situation around you to change.

dialogue.content: その中で、あなた自身を大切にしてい欲しいです
dialogue.English: In that, I want you to take good care of yourself.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: いじめについては、犯罪です周囲の大人の理解がないということに疑問を感じます
dialogue.English: Bullying is a crime. I question the lack of understanding among the adults around you.

dialogue.content: ＜連絡＞　ぺんぺんさん、すみません！　時間が過ぎてしまいましたね。　中途半端なロールプレイとなって申し訳ありません
dialogue.English: <Notice> Penpen-san, I'm so sorry! It looks like our time is up. I apologize that the role-play is ending in the middle of things.

dialogue.content: いえいえ、こちらこそありがとうございました！とても勉強になりました！
dialogue.English: No, no, thank you very much! It was a great learning experience!

dialogue.content: お疲れ様でした１
dialogue.English: Thank you for the session!

dialogue.content: ちなみにぺんぺんさんは、今回女子中学生の役ということで良かったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: By the way, your role this time was a female middle school student, is that correct?

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます今後にいかしていきます重ねて本日はありがとうございました！
dialogue.English: Thank you. I'll make use of this going forward. Again, thank you very much for today!

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました！
dialogue.English: Thank you very much!

dialogue.content: 失礼します！
dialogue.English: Goodbye!
